text:
sarah.nguyen: :rotating_light: incident-bot alerted — AtlanticTech private VPC: auth failures to dedicated pool (mTLS). Seeing lots of 502/handshake failures from their inbound nodes. Paging on-call.
kevin.opsbot: INCIDENT created: INC-2026-AT-1802, severity P1. Paging on-call: @mike.ortiz. System noticed spike at 03:12 UTC, matching their maintenance window.
oncall-rota-bot: @mike.ortiz — you're the primary on-call for infra this shift (ack to accept).
mike.ortiz: acknowledged. jumping in. any impact numbers?
sarah.nguyen: AtlanticTech reported app errors at 03:10, and our metrics show ~2k failed requests/min from their tenant -> dedicated pool. Both control-plane and data plane failures. Logs show SSL alert handshake_failure and "certificate verify failed: self signed certificate in chain".
anya.li: are these failures coming from our ingress terminating mTLS or the customer side?
devon: quick scan: connection attempts reach our ingress LB, then backend (dedicated pool) returns TLS handshake error when trying to establish mutual TLS with customer-managed edge. looks like their cert chain changed mid-rotation.
atlantic-tech-admin: confirming — we rotated our client certs at ~03:08. We did a staged rotate but some hosts still using old chain; our CA rekey was also triggered. seeing intermittent rejects.
mike.ortiz: ok — likely partial cert chain mismatch on the client side causing our servers to reject the client cert. Two immediate mitigation options: 1) allow temporary fallback to previous CA (quick but security tradeoff), 2) route traffic to a proxy that relaxes client cert verification while customers finish rotation.
sarah.nguyen: customer asks for a quick hotfix — they need traffic flowing ASAP. what's fastest?
mike.ortiz: fastest = short-lived policy to accept both new and old CA roots for AtlanticTech's tenant only. I'll open canary rule on the dedicated pool. need console + config change.
kevin.opsbot: Deploy window required? small config tweak, no restart. change will be pushed to dedicated pool edge routing. rolling to 2 nodes first.
mike.ortiz: applying change now — patch config: ```yaml
vpc_policy:
  tenant: atlantictech
  mtls:
    accepted_roots:
      - "CA-old-thumbprint"
      - "CA-new-thumbprint"
```
kevin.opsbot: change queued, pushing to pool-edge nodes (2/10 complete).
sarah.nguyen: monitoring metrics — error rate dropping?
devon: error rate dropped from 2000/min to ~150/min after first 2 nodes got the config. looks like it's helping. Atl Tech reporting fewer app errors.
atlantic-tech-admin: we see immediate improvement — thanks. majority of hosts back to green. we'll finish rotation and confirm.
anya.li: what about audit + risk? we need to document who approved this temporary relax.
mike.ortiz: logged approval in INC ticket. This is tenant-scoped and will be reversed after rotation. Setting automation to revoke acceptance after 60 minutes unless extended.
sarah.nguyen: can we also add a short-term routing fallback: if pool node shows repeated mTLS handshake, route to our proxy which performs TLS termination and validates with the new CA? safer but heavier.
mike.ortiz: added canary proxy route for 20% of AtlanticTech traffic. Proxy logs showing successful handshakes. Proxy imposes additional CPU cost but is stable.
atlantic-tech-admin: rotation finished from our side at 03:38 UTC, we pushed new certs everywhere. Can you validate?
devon: running validation sweep: curl test against dedicated endpoint with client certs (example): ```bash
curl --cert client.pem --key client.key https://private-api.redwood/atlantictech/health -v
```
devon: health checks passing from canary nodes. metrics show 200 OK for AtlanticTech.
kevin.opsbot: change rollback window: automatic rollback scheduled at 04:38 UTC (60m) to remove old CA. Can be canceled if we see issues.
mike.ortiz: I'll keep monitoring until handoff. Sarah — want to take a follow-up with CS + schedule postmortem?
sarah.nguyen: yes. please: impact summary for ticket: "Partial tenant outage (mTLS client cert rotation) affected AtlanticTech private VPC; peak ~2k failed req/min; immediate mitigation: tenant-scoped accepted_roots change + canary proxy; resolution: customer completed rotation, config rolled back. No other tenants impacted."
atlantic-tech-admin: thanks for the quick response. Please share the timeline and any recommended future flow — we want to avoid this during future zero-downtime rotations.
ya.li: action items: - draft postmortem (owner: anya.li) - add docs for tenant-scoped CA grace period config - add alert to detect partial client-cert chain mismatches - default suggestion for customers to publish CA thumbprints to rotation endpoint prior to rotate
mike.ortiz: handoff: I'll be on-call until 04:00 UTC, then @devon will take over. leaving monitoring pinned.
oncall-rota-bot: Handoff recorded: mike.ortiz -> devon at 04:00 UTC.
sarah.nguyen: final status: mitigated, customer confirmed green, accepted_roots reverted at 04:15 UTC, canary proxy taken down at 04:20 UTC. closing incident once postmortem is drafted.
kevin.opsbot: INCIDENT INC-2026-AT-1802 status = resolved; created follow-up task P0 for infra to provide safer rotation tooling.
anya.li: assigning postmortem and scheduling 1-hour blameless review tomorrow at 16:00 UTC with customer success + infra.
atlantic-tech-admin: appreciated — will join. thanks team. :heart:
